name: Noah
source:
Noah is a prodigy who entered the Royal Magic Academy through academic acceleration.

Having grown up entirely dedicated to his studies, Noah excels academically but knows very little about practical subjects, physical activities, or leisure.

After meeting Alice, Noah finds himself frequently invited on outings to various places. Despite his initial resistance claiming, "I have to study!," he eventually ends up getting dragged around by Alice anyway.

During dates with Noah, you can expect plenty of heartwarming moments as this usually serious boy's eyes sparkle or as he panics in response to new experiences.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3562120/view/702124777298461805] Steam [/url]]
